details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:23-25,165,513 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: D16 moves the scaler to tools/runner_scaler/ but all other references (source_dir, python -m runner_scaler, registry entry, Files & Modules) still use top-level runner_scaler/.
  WHY: The package or build context ends up in the wrong place, so the deploy fails or the implementation conflicts with R3; severity disagreement (minimax: BLOCKER, others: MAJOR), highest used.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:48,159,197 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The runs-on expression has no coding-workflows repository guard, and the scaler-side skip rule (D15) has no implementing module or test.
  WHY: If PIPELINE_RUNS_ON=do-runner is set on coding-workflows, its own jobs queue with no runner, violating G8; minimax rated the task-gap form BLOCKER.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:297 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Boot step 4 passes --jitconfig to ./run.sh, whereas the other reviewers say it belongs on ./config.sh.
  WHY: The runner may not register, so droplets time out as boot failures and the breaker opens. Severity disagreement: BLOCKER from gemini, minimax and openai; MAJOR from glm; NIT from sonnet, which disputes the claim and says --jitconfig is correct on run.sh (confidence 2).
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:208-217,338 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The intake calls skip-reason at scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh lines 618 and 627, before jobs data is read around line 1764, and skip_reason() takes no jobs or annotations input.
  WHY: The runner_lost branch is never reached on the intake path, so heal issues are still filed and the heal-intake half of G6 is unmet.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:244,296-297 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Both a failed boot self-check and a normally completed job end with the droplet powered off, and nothing distinguishes the two.
  WHY: Successful jobs can be counted as boot failures and open the circuit breaker (G5) with no real fault.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:251-256 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The re-run fires on the job-level completed event, but GitHub rejects re-runs while sibling jobs are still running, and the plan has no run-completion gate or retry.
  WHY: G6 holds only for single-job runs.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:227-228,277 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The reconcile full scan lists only queued runs, so queued jobs inside in_progress runs are missed; the scan replaces the webhook-maintained set and is capped at 50 runs per repository.
  WHY: After a missed webhook, those jobs never get a droplet.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:215,252-256,391 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The GitHub App permission list omits Checks: read, which the check-run annotations endpoint requires.
  WHY: The annotations read returns 403, so lost-runner detection, the re-run and the heal skip silently fail.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:30-33,228,247-260,495 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan claims the scaler keeps no state, but the queued set, breaker counters and alert dedup cooldowns are in-process.
  WHY: A restart resets the breaker and alerts, so the crash-recovery claim is inaccurate.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:242-246 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: There is no idle destruction rule for a registered droplet whose job was cancelled before assignment.
  WHY: The droplet lives up to 300 minutes, holding a cap slot and costing money, which contradicts D6.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:227,277-283 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A reconcile pass on every webhook, debounced to one per 5 seconds across 7 repositories, allows up to about 5,040 calls an hour, against a stated budget of about 600.
  WHY: The 5,000/hour installation limit is hit and passes are skipped as rate_limited when droplets are needed.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:153,236-240,372,387,511-513 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: RUNNER_SCALER_VPC_UUID (D14) is absent from the droplet-create parameters, app.yaml, README and tests, and contradicts the §4 default rule; the cap of 60 has no env var name.
  WHY: Droplets land in the default VPC, or the implementer must invent undocumented names.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:290-297 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Install pinned packages" heading is inaccurate because only the actions/runner release is SHA-256 checked.
  WHY: gh and docker.io are unpinned, which overstates the supply-chain guarantee and the contract test.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:490 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The JIT config in droplet user data stays readable via the metadata service to job code, and the plan has no concrete mitigation such as an iptables drop.
  WHY: This is an accepted but unmitigated exposure; sonnet notes it is an accepted documented risk.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:227-235 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Duplicate queued webhooks can over-create droplets, because supply reads 0 until the runner registers.
  WHY: The reconcile arithmetic is not idempotent against duplicate delivery, with only the cap limiting the damage.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:217,336-338 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Runs with mixed do-runner and ubuntu-latest failed jobs have undocumented runner_lost handling, and it is unclear whether the re-run excludes the do-runner job.
  WHY: A heal issue is filed with unclear intent.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:180,165 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The §6 collision check names runner_scaler/ while D16 chooses tools/runner_scaler/.
  WHY: The collision check is unverified for the actual chosen name.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:41 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The plan names security-audit.yml as the only ubuntu-24.04 workflow, but drift-audit.yml:20 and review_autofix_sweep.yml:123 also use it.
  WHY: The narrative is factually wrong about the repository.
- docs/plans/digitalocean-runners-for-consumer-pipelines-plan.md:329 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Step 1.3's test does not cover the unset-variable fallback to ubuntu-latest (G2).
  WHY: G2's no-op promise is not locked by the described test.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint job 134929106985, static-checks job 134914169691) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Both CI checks failed at scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh with outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed because the PR head is behind main.
  WHY: This is not a defect in the PR; update the branch and re-run.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G8: every coding-workflows job keeps running on GitHub-hosted runners whatever the variable says (D15)
  expected_change_site: Phase 1 steps 1.1/1.3 runs-on expression (line 197) and the Phase 2 scaler tests under step 2.6
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: no repository guard in the expression, no step or test for the scaler skipping coding-workflows, and step 1.3's test would lock in the unguarded expression
- requirement: Every new env var has a default (§4); G3 cap of 60; D14 RUNNER_SCALER_VPC_UUID
  expected_change_site: Approach Droplet creation (line 236), step 2.3 config.py, step 2.4 app.yaml, step 2.7 README
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: no env var is named for the 60-droplet cap, and RUNNER_SCALER_VPC_UUID is absent from the droplet-create parameters, app.yaml, README and tests
- requirement: Phase 1 ships the heal-intake skip, and G6 says no heal issue is filed for a lost-runner failure
  expected_change_site: step 1.5 (line 338) and skip_reason() at scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3180
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: the annotation fetch is placed around line 1764 but the skip-reason calls are at lines 618 and 627, and skip_reason() has no jobs parameter
- requirement: Phase 2 droplet boot script registers a self-hosted runner from the JIT config
  expected_change_site: Droplet boot script step 4 (line 297)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: it reads ./run.sh --jitconfig, and the plan has no separate registration step (this contradicts the sonnet reviewer's view)
- requirement: Phase 2 deploys runner_scaler/ as an App Platform service
  expected_change_site: step 2.4 (line 372) and R3 (line 510-513)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: source_dir: runner_scaler conflicts with D16 and R3's tools/runner_scaler/app.yaml
- requirement: GitHub App permission list covers the scaler's API calls
  expected_change_site: step 2.7 (line 391)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Checks: read is omitted though the annotations endpoint is called
- requirement: G2: with no consumer setting PIPELINE_RUNS_ON, every job runs exactly as today
  expected_change_site: step 1.3 test (line 329)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: no test for the unset-variable fallback
- requirement: Step 1.3 test enumeration of ubuntu-24.04 workflows
  expected_change_site: step 1.3 (line 329) and line 41
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: drift-audit.yml:20 and review_autofix_sweep.yml:123 also use ubuntu-24.04
=== EN
